author: Kwong Mingkwei
body: 耀新哥，mco的时候，它给红股，我就注意它了，当时10多块，嫌它贵，去买便宜的，结果它的高盈利又把它带到20块，我看到它的管理层那么好很想买来投资，最后还是下不了手，因为之前10多块没有买，现在你们看看它的价钱，等于当初的几十块钱。所以讲完一句话投资要跟对老板，投机也一样要知道老板在做什么，有没有能力炒到你要的价位，不懂头不懂尾就下手，结果就会出现进退两难，卖也不是，不卖也不是，只能等，非常被动…老板在这个时候就会落井下石让你信心动摇卖出来给他，现在只有一招当作没有看到…

author: Kwong Mingkwei
body: pahang哥，好的东西不会没有人要，看看市场给它什么价就知道了。全世界很多大富翁，他们的资产都是越来越多的，他们知道怎么钱赚钱。如果你看到相反的事情发生，你的头脑肯定会出现疑问，怎么会这样？怎么会欠债越来越多？信心大打折扣的时候，就会采取观望，若它的表现一再让人失望，人人都会退避三舍，未来前景让人担忧，难道真的要想你讲卖地还债？到时候还有多少人留下了陪林老板重组公司？

author: Leong ginn woei
body:
赌场股下跌的趋势不是只有在我国发生，连澳门，澳洲和美国都是同步发生。

这些国家，没有绿潮，没有第二代管理层，也没有相同的经济状况(就是所谓的经济好不好/股市指数高不高)。

种种的不同点之中，是什么因素造成它们同步下跌。

这才是我们需要理解和找出来逻辑。

author: Leong ginn woei
body:
Rys, 你有进场和出场的机制吗？

你买这只股票，有没有设定股价涨或跌，到什么价钱或多少巴仙，就要离场。

或是

你期待的基本面因素转好的概率有多高？

这概率值得你持有等待它的发生吗？

如果真的发生反转了，你预期的回报是多少？它值得让你忍受目前的账目亏损吗？

思考了这些情况，你才做自己的决定会比较好。

新加坡云顶集团正在推进圣淘沙名胜世界（Resorts World Sentosa, RWS）的“2.0升级计划”，该计划包括酒店翻新、会议中心升级以及新增娱乐设施。节庆酒店已完成改造并于2024年初重新开放。迈克尔酒店和康乐福豪华酒店的翻新正在分阶段进行，预计2025年初能全面完成。同时，大规模扩建福廊（The Forum）区域预计将于2025年投入使用。

此扩建项目意在吸引更多高端游客，并提升整体旅游体验，迎合后疫情时代逐步复苏的旅游需求

body: Genting's 15.5-acre waterfront site in Miami is considered a prime location. It is situated in the Omni District, offering approximately 800 feet of Biscayne Bay frontage. The property benefits from highly favorable zoning, including unlimited buildable square footage, no setbacks, and the ability to build structures up to 649 feet tall. author: KengChew
body:
假若你们是老板，知道股价一定会被踢出TOP 30,一直跌会跌倒基金佬恐慌性抛售，但你却手握60亿现金…你们会不会这样急就赶着进场…

隔岸观火的老板，等你们和基金佬搞乱一团，就来一个海底捞月+渔翁得利…

首先我们看看两家公司的cash flow 有没有问题…

如果一家公司的cash flow 越减越少…就是你们准备走佬的日子了…

但是我会看财报的朋友说cash flow 是由始mco 以来创新高…

有问题的公司哪里会cash flow 越来越少

，要记得还不起钱的公司才会倒…而不是越借越多钱的公司会倒…

这一次云顶双雄跌出Top 30 也是老板预料之内，狠心的策略一张都不买，任由市场卖票暴跌…老板会不会心痛…答案是不会…因为老板的薪水还是一样2-3个亿…

手握现金的老板如果不看戏，恐慌性时候拾票，难道要等到回去Top 30 的时候买票吗…

我个人觉得老板再后续两天会把云顶below & below market 的票 扫到干干净净…

你们知道一旦下个季度云顶股价随便上到去rm4.5以上，就可能有机会回到top 30 , 到时老板手上的股票现金抵押可以从60亿去到90亿…凭空捏造30亿还有多余的票在手上玩…

有什么会比你觉得做有把握的…赚自己知道以内钱更好赚…简直就是double win win 啦…连基金佬这次也被老板做一枪…高招…你怪我帝国无情…我笑你卖票白痴…

这是我个人搞笑分析出来的结果…不要吊我…以上只是个人留言开玩笑…当作笑话看看就好，不要太认真，毕竟不是每个人像柴9有那么多个10年去等…比如像我

author: Michael Saw
body:
拉斯维加斯名胜世界（Resorts World Las Vegas, RWLV）宣布的重要重组和战略推进的要点：

1. 加强领导团队：

任命行业资深人士、前MGM度假村（MGM Resorts）首席执行官吉姆·穆伦（Jim Murren）为董事会主席。

亚历克斯·迪克森（Alex Dixon）将于2025年1月起担任首席执行官。他拥有深厚的博彩、酒店和房地产行业经验。

2. 首次成立董事会：

RWLV首次组建董事会，成员涵盖博彩法律、人力资源战略和公司治理等多领域专家。

董事会旨在加强治理、推动增长战略，并巩固RWLV作为拉斯维加斯顶级目的地的地位。

author: Michael Saw
body:
3. 战略增长潜力：

RWLV拥有42英亩未开发土地，在拉斯维加斯市场中具有独特的未来扩展优势。

4. 云顶集团的长期愿景：

作为云顶集团（Genting Berhad）的全资子公司，RWLV受益于其近六十年的综合度假村运营经验。此次重组与云顶集团在全球提升运营效率的目标一致。

此次重组不仅彰显了RWLV的雄心，还突显了云顶集团在竞争激烈的拉斯维加斯市场中实现创新和领导地位的承诺。对于利益相关者而言，这些变化预示着增长和价值创造的全新阶段。

author: Michael Saw
body:
Resorts World Las Vegas announces board members, CEO

TheStar Fri, Dec 06, 2024 01:01pm - 14 minutes

KUALA LUMPUR: Genting Bhd's indirect wholly-owned subsidiary Resorts World Las Vegas LLC has announced the formation of a board of directors who assumed their roles on Dec 4, 2024, with industry veteran Jim Murren as the chairman.

The Las Vegas gaming outfit also announced the appointment of Alex Dixon, who will come on board on Jan 16, 2025, as its CEO.

"With over 40 years of collective experience in the global gaming and hospitality industry, we are confident that Alex and Jim, alongside the Board, will help drive the company forward in pursuing our strategic goals for years to come," said Genting chairman and chief executive Lim Kok Thay in a statement.

Murren was previously the CEO and chairman at MGM Resorts, and currently holds leadership positions with Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection, the General Commercial Gaming Regulatory Authority in the United Arab Emirates, Cirque du Soleil, and Playstudios, as well as serving as a trustee on Howard University’s Board of Trustees.

author: cheng
body:
I think its more than enough on its plate now, Kyory :) Leisure and hospitality is the cash cow for Genting's group. They should continue to use the cash generated from leisure and hospitality to scale up the other segments. Oil and gas is making good progress with first drop of LNG in 2026. Biotech investments relatively small but yet to see significant returns yet. This is expected due to the nature of the industry - extensive in R&D research followed by regulatory compliance. Once these two are completed, the returns will kick in. Thats what we are seeing with HMTM by TauRx which is at the regulatory compliance phase - marketing authorization. As for the stem cell facility in Indonesia, its a good start and you can refer to the summary here on the industry

author: Leong ginn woei
body:
左侧交易，没有错。

但是需要有策略去执行。

举个例子:

如果我要在云顶这只股票上赚钱，目标是2年赚40%，股价从RM3.60涨到RM5.04。

这时候，我要计算

云顶的各国赌场，种植，能源，迈亚密卖地，老人药，

能不能在这两年内有好进展。

如果有好进展，股价先跑，一定会脱离盘整区，让我们有足够的时间进场买票上车。

RM3.80, RM4.00, RM4.20慢慢买上去。

当趋势反转了，就不容易逆转。

我用比现在股价贵多RM0.20,RM40,RM0.60，来买一个确定性，时间成本和机会成本，值得。

你的策略是什么？

author: Leong ginn woei
body:
两年40%，平均一年20%。

如果我不把钱放在这个下跌趋势股票，反而放在其他领域的股票，如40天前我所说的油棕，科技，手套。

20%，40天可能已经达标了。

就算这个40天，你没有上到车，没有赚到这笔20%，2025年里还有9个40天(360天)可以给你机会和时间慢慢找更有性价比/盈亏比的股票。

哪一个策略比较好，哪一个达标的概率比较大?

author: Han
body:
這只股票明明一路在跌，但是報章上的文章都是一路看好，什麽“股價已反應負面因素”，“業績回升可收復失地","已跌出价值".

一堆基金嘴上說這麽看好，但是我翻了幾個星期MIDF的基金净賣出和外資净賣出的十大排行榜，常常可以看到雲頂。證明基金也沒在買入。

這些新聞擺明是寫給我們散戶看的吧。

應該是基金和外資天天一直都在丟票，丟票丟到連他們都怕了，要搞一些招數來吸引我們這些小散戶支撐一下股價。

但是這招一點用都沒有，小散戶的資金根本不足夠吸收基金和外資的賣盤。

真要支撐股價應該用share buy back，但是share buy back要用公司錢，老闆應該不想或不捨得。

author: Kwong Mingkwei
body: 怎么你和我都想到一块去？Share buy back 要股东批准，要发通告。目前他在用他自己的私房钱，每年拿那么多钱，就是为了今天，你说有没有这个可能性？不过话又说回来，发好消息都是割韭菜用的，难道他想割韭菜？想到都怕怕…

author: Han
body:
雲頂正在用錢之際，一邊正在競標紐約賭牌，贏了賭牌起碼要投資最少RM30億，另一邊RM50億正在投資能源業務，另一邊新加坡那裏要RWS2.0翻新要RM330億。

明年債務比例有點吃緊，應該不大可能玩share buy back。

放好消息也有可能因爲股價跌到老闆都怕了，要散戶進來提振一下股價。

或者是基金要離場，要散戶進來接一下票。

不過老闆肚子裏面的想法我們很難猜得到，還是集中留意公司的盈利能力好了。

author: Leong ginn woei
body:
数学课:

如果在云顶买了

RM4.80,

RM4.50,

RM4.33(传言是500粒，一共是马币二百一十六万五千令吉，

也有可能是500lot,一共是马币二十一万六千五百令吉)

RM4.00,

RM3.80。

这批股票的平均价不详，但是当股价跌到RM3.60的时候，传言中的亏损是马币三十万令吉。

假设如果这些价位都是同样的股票数额＝500粒 或是 500lot。

4.8+4.5+4.33+4.00+3.8＝21.43

21.43除于5个价位，平均价是RM4.286

如果每次的价位都是500粒，那么500粒✘5个价位是2500粒。

RM4.286✘2500粒＝马币一千零七十一万五千令吉。

如果是500lot,那么就是

RM4.286✘2500lot＝马币一百零七万一千五百令吉。

30万的亏损，

如果在一千万的本金里，就是3%的亏损

如果在一百万的本金里，就是30%的亏损。

這家公司是不是得罪全馬所有基金和外資呀？

MIDF最新的資金流動報告裏，外資和本地機構就是對手盤，外資賣什麽，本地機構就買什麽，外資買什麽，本地機構就賣什麽。

比如本地機構大賣CIMB RM 68M，外資就大買RM 72M。外資大丟gamudaRM1.17億,本地機構就大買gamudaRM 1億。

10大資金流入流出排行榜裏，只有雲頂雙雄不吃這套，外資大賣genting和genm，本地機構就完美避開不接盤，似乎外資和本地機構有共識就是誰也不入手雲頂雙雄，所有票都給散戶接。

真的是外資不疼，本地機構不愛。

author: Tan Gavin
body:
好久没上云顶 … 给我的感觉怎么这里怪怪了呢 ？感觉一切都变了？回不去了吗？ 很多人说这是不会倒的行业 … 其实海外常有赌厅倒闭的事。被赌客赌倒了？还是经营不善倒了呢 ？

云顶那的用餐体验 … meh 简单的说说就是选择也没多少，喝酒的酒吧街也许我没这习惯 … 差不多10点左右就准备回酒店睡觉了。 可能来的是周日人潮不是很拥挤 … 所以气氛就不是很可以。

游乐设施 … skyworld 没进去 … 但在室内的就发现有很多小型的游乐机，放在山下的广场都已经很多没人玩了...

整体的感觉体验 … 就是乱。朋友说可能是装修吧，我相信可能吧 … 过渡期。虽然我不赌，但是偶尔旅游也会去看看，感受那氛围及气派，但这里的感觉怎么好像怪怪的， 还是我多虑了呢 ？

市场正密切关注云顶是否会参与投标泰国赌场。

author: Leong ginn woei
body:
数学题:

4.6-3.6＝1

3.6要赚1，就需要27.8%。

短时间内，要赚到这赚幅，方法是

1.思考马股主要趋势的领域里，哪个的回撤的幅度是最大的

2.如果这领域还在上升趋势，或是政府或市场资金(外资，基金，国家队，散户)还是会投钱进去的一个领域，胜算才是最高的。

3.不需要一次过赚这27.8%，只需要3次的9%，你就可以回本了。(前提是本金和盈利都投回进去)

如果9%很难，那么6次5%，也是可以做到。

4. 一年有12个月，平均4个月有一个季度报告出炉，可以看哪个领域是有成长的前景。

每次赚一个10%，不难。

如果云顶在2月的季度报告(去年的第四季度是旺季)出来是爆赚50亿或是100亿，股价从3.60gap up去到4.00以上，你依然有足够的时间买入，从4.00涨去5.00(25%)，或是5.50(37.5%)。

有现金，怕买不到股票咩。

最怕是拿着涨不上去的股票，换不到钱去买其他暴涨的股票。

author: Leong ginn woei

你们就是被人带风向，相信了他们要你们继续拿票的理由。

author: Leong ginn woei
body:
Sf,我中过的套，经验也是很多。

主要是在2022年居多。

当中印象最深的是

1.harta

从3.80的支撑点gap down到3.45，买了第一批货。

跌到3.28，再摊平一次。

跌到3.05，全部卖完，不到一个星期就亏了10多%。

那时的harta卖压很重，涨一点马上丢一堆的票，我看了都怕。

2.mnholding,

2023年追高，进了0.28的货，过后大市不好，股价回调至0.25，最低时到了0.235。

股价在漫长的半年里一直横盘，当它反弹至0.25就止损离场。

当时的我是看好公司的业务，但它就是一季好，下一季就亏，洗我们散户离场。我等不了，就离场。

后来的多一季的业绩大好，加上拿到新合同和数据中心的主题加持，股价大涨。

我错过了这波涨潮。

author: 御风破浪
body: 除了股民和一些中产阶级不满安华政府之外，其实很多公务员，底层人民都受过安华政府昌明经济的恩惠。 昌明经济说白了就是“劫富安贫”的政策。 而安华之所以要高调支援巴勒斯坦，其实是为了抢在伊党之前凝聚国内穆斯林团体。 还记得安华执政初期，有几次补选，伊党都大获全胜，国内绿潮有做大做强之势，团结政府加强了国家对穆斯林教育体系，高调支援巴勒斯坦，是抢先一步凝聚国内穆斯林，如果政府不这么做，伊党就会以此号召国内穆斯林挺巴勒斯坦，发起聚会游行等活动，到时伊党势力会越来越壮大，国家将会更趋向于保守极端。 近期爆发了GISB 儿童之家丑闻，绿潮才有所消退。 安华才马不停蹄去外国访问招商。

author: 御风破浪
body: 国库没钱，源于一马公司丑闻+新冠期间实施mco 大出血，这个窟窿怎么也要填补，只能拿有钱人开刀。 其实底层人民，公务员在最低薪资不断调高+薪&政府补贴下，生活条件获得一定程度的改善。 之所以这么说，是因为去年开始，发现很多马来人都涌入泰国旅游，这是一个异于往常的现象，也显示马来人的经济确实在加薪，调涨最低工资的环境下，有闲钱可以出去旅游了。

author: Sia Investment
body:
As of late February 2025, TauRx is still awaiting a response from the Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (MHRA) on its application for hydromethylthionine mesylate (HMTM). HMTM is a tablet that could treat mild cognitive impairment and mild to moderate Alzheimer's disease.

Explanation

TauRx has submitted an application to the MHRA for HMTM.

The MHRA requested additional information from TauRx, and a response is due in late February 2025.

TauRx has also completed a Phase III clinical trial called LUCIDITY.

The LUCIDITY trial studied the effect of HMTM on patients with mild cognitive impairment and mild to moderate Alzheimer's disease.

The trial used brain scans, blood tests, and cognitive tests to measure how well HMTM might slow down Alzheimer's disease.

The results from earlier trials have shown that HMTM has a clinically meaningful therapeutic effect on cognitive decline and brain shrinkage.

TauRx is a global leader in tau-based research for treating Alzheimer's disease.

author: Vin Vin
body:
Hock,

吉隆坡（2月18日）：云台Bhd（KL：GENTING）的PT Layar Nusantara Gas拥有95%的间接子公司成功铺设了其浮动液化天然气（FLNG）设施的第一个船体基尔块。

被称为“Alam Guyub”的FLNG设施基尔奠基仪式在距离上海约135公里的中国江苏省南通的Wison New Energies Co Ltd造船厂举行。

Genting在周二的一份声明中表示，该仪式标志着云正和印度尼西亚的第一个FLNG设施正式进入核心建设阶段。

有品牌的

亚洲能源奖表彰卓越能源转型

随着世界与前所未有的环境挑战作斗争，变革性领导力、大胆的创新解决方案和技术部署的需求从未如此紧迫——而亚洲是这一努力的核心。

FLNG设施目前已完工40%，Wison正在其南通造船厂根据工程、采购、施工、安装和调试（EPCIC）合同建造。

去年6月，Genting授予了价值9.628亿美元（42.8亿令吉）的EPCIC合同。

仪式由云庭董事长兼首席执行官Tan Sri Lim Kok Thay和Wison董事长Liu Hongjun主持。

author: Kwong Mingkwei
body: 美国的生意，从前年的税前盈利4亿跌到去年的8千2百万，投资项目的开销增加到37亿，整体的债务是392亿，没有减少再增加多3亿。种植业和发电项目有进步，税前盈利贡献1亿5千万。整体上看起来是退步，营业额少掉几十亿，博彩业的表现差强人意，营业额跌9%，马来西亚的保持，新加坡跌10%，美国跌19%。总结，集团还是在靠博彩业贡献盈利，美国的生意就像寄生虫，不断地吸着集团的血，巨额的投资换回来几千万的盈利，这样的情形维持了很多年，相信集团更本就不想再拿新的执照，因为又要花很多费用，有可能让集团陷得更深。

author: Kelvin Tan
body: 一切的错都是从收购帝国度假村开始，当年原本是林氏一间公司拥有的。后来债务亏损翻不了身，不顾当年投资者反对就拉大马云顶进场。每年一直吸大马云顶的钱 从20%股权到现在70%多。所以股价走势在从收购帝国开始就走下坡。之后的几年不断搞能源转行收购。但问题是一个帝国都搞不好又一直向外延伸。转型又是从银行哪里融资。一但债务堆起来 反而收购回来的业务管理不成熟导致亏损。最后得到的结果是债务越来越高，亏损扩大而已。债务利息每分每秒24小时不停跑。滚雪球 ，以往的历史都是很多看起来大到很难倒下的国际公司都是被债务压死的。大亏都是从小亏开始。当你要卖资产地皮还债，其他买家也不傻。做背景调查就知道卖主什么状况。一起耗下去，耗到看谁急了就贱价卖贱价收。外国很多办公大厦拍卖都无人问津

author: Kelvin Tan
body: 朋友，你试下问2020前7块多买入的股东 看他们是不是从2018开始骂了。有时要分清楚股票下跌的原因。受情绪影响抛受还是基本面受损而抛售？上星期的业绩月，有不同领域的公司还是实现了盈利创新和订单增长。隔天股价也是标了一些青。只是这几天受到外围因素的影响才导致股价回撤。一但乌云散去，这些公司的股价一定是领先跑 浮现该有的价值。然而那些基本面受损+情绪影响的并不会跑几远 也不会站很稳。股市是个多人博弈的游戏 不是单机游戏。股价是反应整个公司总体盈利强弱水平。强或弱间接影响投资者对它的期望高还是低。市场是不会差别待遇任何一间公司。强者则强 股价也是创新高，弱者则弱 股价是穿新低。创新创低都是时间问题。乌云迷雾时，可以去接股价回撤 但不是去接创新低的股。如果云顶上回4块5块然后稳稳直上就是证明他本身一部分问题已经解决。不会无缘无故上，就算有上也是靠不真实的消息炒上来，最后也是站不稳。现在短期进场是fifo,长期的“赌”新的管理层，“赌”老人药，“赌”新赌牌，“赌”业绩回温。并没有任何投资可言。投资是投在过往至今的真实数据上的成长，资入该公司良好的方向发展和优秀的管理层。为投资者在未来创造更多的财富

author: Sf Wong
body:
（吉隆坡12日讯）时隔近4年，丹斯里林国泰与家族首次购入云顶（GENTING，3182，主要板消费）股票，展现对自家股票的强力支持。

过去一周，林氏家族已购入726万的云顶股票，价值达2286万令吉。林国泰私人投资机构建发实业私人有限公司（Kien Huat Realty）也扫入600万股；而林国泰长子拿督林拱辉也买进126万股。

分析师指出，林氏家族此次的购股行动，显示对云顶的强力支持，特别是该公司股价自2月底公布财报以来，已经下跌多达18%。

author: Sf Wong
body:
有鉴于此，马银行研究相信云顶当前估值已全面反映核心平均股本回酬（ROAE）减少的利空，并相信短期估值有潜在重估的利多因素。

首先，云顶持股20％的卓睿药业（TauRx）所研发的阿兹海默症药物审批有望在4月至6月期间接获英国药品与保健产品管理局（MHRA）回复，若顺利获批，该行预估卓睿药业估值料达15亿美元，届时云顶每股估值可达5令吉零9仙。

“第二，NGCB对RWLV的调查可能有正面消息，届时其业务营运将会全面复苏。”

不过，马银行研究认为，云顶大马（GENM,4715,主板消费产品服务组）与RAV巴哈马就比尼米名胜世界（RWB）的6亿美元（约26亿6100万令吉）索赔案件将在6月结案，万一败诉将在短期内对云顶大马与云顶的股价带来重大风险。

“综合以上，虽然我们维持云顶3令吉98仙目标价不变，但碍于其股价自第四季财报揭盅后已回调超过10%，当前股价将提供23%的潜在上涨空间，加上3%的周息率，上调其投资评级，从‘守住’提高至‘买进’。”

body: Kc,老板一次过买进600万股，几次出手一共买下来有1700股以上。整间公司有38亿8千万股，就是1.7/388x100=0.438 。回购的股票还不到0.5%，也要登报纸公告天下，为了是什么？我是关心你们，不是关心云顶。股票对我来说只是赚钱的工具，买卖心中有一定的标准，度量衡，不达标的公司被我抛到九霄云外去。

author: Kwong Mingkwei
body: 看过有的人喜欢买进暴跌的股，从低点反弹，越赚越多，等到信心满满大量买入的时候来一个大跌，全部被绑住，一次过把赢的钱输光，还要连老本也赔进去。输了钱不甘愿卖，还去买来补，等到股市越跌越低，手上的钱补光了，没有钱再买，只好等待股市反弹，偏偏弹来弹去也弹不回本钱，卖又亏，又舍不得，最后干脆不要看股票，不玩了。原因只有一个选错股，看到暴跌以为是机会，哪里知道老板一直在为自己制造机会在卖，看似起，其实是相反。公司暴跌必然有重大事故，不去了解，就贸然买进，是兵家大忌。

author: cheng
body:
The UK’s National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has issued further draft guidance reaffirming its decision not to recommend the Alzheimer’s treatments Kisunla (donanemab) and Leqembi (lecanemab) for use on the National Health Service (NHS) in England.

This is the second time NICE made a decision not to approve these treatments for NHS use. Leqembi, marketed by Biogen and Eisai, was first rejected for NHS coverage in August 2024, while a negative coverage decision for Eli Lilly’s Kisunla came in October 2024.

Following a request for additional evidence, NICE’s independent appraisal committee reviewed new data but maintained its stance that the medicines are not cost-effective. NICE stated that neither treatment provides sufficient benefit to justify the significant cost of provision and administration within the NHS.

The committee concluded that even under a managed access arrangement – where drugs are provided at a discounted price for a fixed period while additional evidence is collected – was not acceptable. “The cost-effectiveness estimates for donanemab and lecanemab remain substantially higher than we can consider an acceptable use of taxpayers’ money and NHS resources,” said NICE in the 6 March announcement.

The draft guidance has now been opened for public consultation, which will close on 27 March 2025, after which NICE will convene a third appraisal meeting to consider responses before issuing final recommendations. Kisunla and Leqembi are both monoclonal antibodies designed to slow early cognitive decline in Alzheimer’s patients by targeting amyloid beta plaques in the brain. The UK’s Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (MHRA) approved both treatments in 2024, becoming the first regulatory agency to do so.

author: Leong ginn woei
body:
你可以转达我的看法:

1.目前的市况

目前是熊市，有很多股票面对很大的卖压。

手握股票的股友，会比手握现金的人，面对更大的精神压力。我会建议他止损一部分的云顶股票(份额，就自己拿捏)，然后手握现金等待熊市中，一些优秀公司更大的股价的调整。

当然，止损是一件令人痛苦的事情。

author: Leong ginn woei
body:
2.翻本，需要计算的数目

2.1 100万，买了4.7的云顶股票，目前的账目亏损是29.78%，这意味着他的损失金额是三十万马币，剩下七十万马币的本金。

2.2 如果要翻本，从七十万回到100万的本金。它需要42.85%的涨幅。

author: kok boon liu
body: leong，你是良师。止损需要很大的勇气。我敬佩敢于止损的多过在股票里赢钱的，不管男女。谢谢。止损和输到受不了止损是有差别的。放心吧！压力？？？吃用都花不了多少了还怕有什么压力？

author: Leong ginn woei
body:
3.翻本的方法

3.1等运到，一切听天由命。

这方法是下策，不可取。

3.2拿股息，弥补股价的损失

目前的一年股息是11仙。

如果每年都是11仙的股息，那么RM1.40的股价损失，需要12.7年的才能拿回这笔损失。

这属于中策。

3.3进行止损(部分/全部)云顶股票，进行换股的策略。

这是上策。

author: Leong ginn woei
body:
4.如果选择换股，如何进行呢？

4.1选择时机

4.2选择赛道

4.3选择龙头股

4.4选择有安全边际，如股息，国家队护盘。。。

4.5选择值博率高的股票

这方面是很复杂的，我有空才详谈。

主观的想法，

需要经过市场验证才能得知自己的策略是否奏效。

如果在2024年的牛市都输钱。

在2025年的熊市中，输钱的概率会更大。

所有的外围因素都不会是主要的理由，因为按下买卖按键的是自己的手指。

不同的思维，会带来不同的效果。

100万，损失30万，剩下70万。

2.我还有70万的本金，依然有翻身的机会。

情绪上是:沉着，冷静，充满斗志

3.觉得70万零吉，依然是一笔很大的数目，可以让我的退休生活不受干扰。

情绪上是:从容，平静

你们是什么思维？

body: IBs are now aligned to potential MAA decision in Apr too :) Genting Bhd's $10.5 million settlement with Nevada regulators on a compliance complaint could encourage gamblers to return to Resorts World Las Vegas, Maybank IB analyst Yin Shao Yang notes. The company retains its license, and the fine represents less than 5% of its 2025 expected earnings, he notes. A rebound in gambler traffic could lift RWLV average quarterly Ebitda to $37.5 million going forward, compared with about $1.5 million in 4Q 2024, he reckons. The Lim family and CEO increasing their stake recently also signals confidence in Genting's long-term value, he says. A potential Alzheimer's drug approval for its associate TauRx Pharmaceuticals in April or May remains a key upside catalyst, he adds. Maybank maintains a buy rating on Genting and keeps target price at MYR3.98. Shares are unchanged at MYR3.32. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)

body:
若出现以下情况，债务风险将显著上升：

1. **令吉暴跌**（如兑美元跌破5.0，外债偿债成本激增）。

2. **国际评级下调**至“垃圾级”，导致外资撤离。

3. **全球衰退**导致出口收入锐减（如半导体、棕榈油需求下降）。

author: Liew Dekka
body:
- **短期**：马来西亚 **不会破产**，因经济韧性较强、债务结构合理。

- **长期**：若财政赤字和补贴问题不解决，债务可能突破GDP **70%** 的红线，增加违约风险。

author: Sf Wong
body:
“远离史诗级市场风暴” 传奇投资者警告:别抄底

Nanyang Fri, Apr 04, 2025 12:09pm - 11 minutes

（纽约4日讯）随着不断加剧的关税担忧重创美国股市，传奇投资人比尔·格罗斯建议那些想要抄底的股票投资者保持观望。

这位太平洋投资管理公司的联合创始人兼前总执行长表示，这场抛售潮是“严重的市场事件”，短期内看不到解决的迹象。

“投资者不应试图‘接住掉落的刀’，”他在电邮中写道。“这是史诗级的经济和市场事件，类似于1971年金本位制终结的情形，只不过负面影响更加立竿见影。”

美国总统特朗普周三宣布了全面的关税政策，对出口到美国的商品征收至少10%的关税。其中最引人注目的是欧盟将被征收20%的关税，日本为24%，中国则面临更高的税率。

标普500指数市值蒸发约2兆美元，基准美国国债收益率一度跌破备受关注的4%关口。

经济学家认为，这些措施短期内将导致美国国内物价上涨和经济增长放缓，甚至可能引发衰退。特朗普将关税视为维护美国实力、重振国内制造业和获取地缘政治让步的工具。

“特朗普不会很快退缩，”格罗斯表示。“他的个性太强硬，不会这么做。”

author: KengChew
body:
研究人员报告了阿尔茨海默病的潜在口服治疗方法，该治疗方法在至少18个月内减缓了其进展。

由新加坡公司TauRx Pharmaceutics Ltd开发，驻阿伯丁的科学家报告称，如果获得监管机构的批准，甲基硫氨酸甲酸氢（HMTM）可能是针对tau蛋白病理的阿尔茨海默病（AD）的首种口服治疗。

这些调查结果于周六在维也纳举行的AD/PD 2025年主要国际会议上公布。在活动中，TauRx Pharmaceuticals首席执行官兼联合创始人Claude Wischik教授概述了将HMTM最近的3期试验结果与AD关键路径（CPAD）研究所数据库中可获得的密切匹配受试者的安慰剂数据进行比较的工作，该数据库包含来自参加36项全球试验的近10,000名患者的信息。

领导这项研究的Wischik教授说：“在将HMTM与外部数据进行比较的三种不同分析中，结果是一致的，表明HMTM在至少18个月内有效减少临床衰退和脑萎缩的进展，潜在的临床意义治疗效果持续两年。

“我们相信，HMTM有可能成为早期至轻度/中度AD的安全和可获得的口服治疗选择，可以以最小的患者和医生负担提供。

“虽然这不是治愈方法，但研究表明，在疾病早期开始HMTM治疗可以大大延缓进展。正如涉及3000多名患者的试验所证明的那样，强大的安全性特征和口服给药相结合，使我们相信我们拥有一种药物，人们可以像服用其他处方药一样服用。”

TauRx已向英国药品和医疗保健产品监管局（MHRA）提交了HMTM的营销授权申请，而该公司还与国家健康和护理卓越研究所（NICE）合作，以评估该药物是否适合用于NHS。

使用ADAS-cog13评分系统进行比较，该系统测量了回忆单词和记忆测试说明等任务的能力，表明，与CPAD安慰剂数据的大幅下降相比，早期疾病服用HMTM的患者在18个月内没有比基线得分明显下降。

此外，对用于对痴呆症严重程度进行全球评估的临床痴呆症评级（CDR）量表的检查显示出类似的结果，脑萎缩的进展是神经退化的客观指标，HMTM数据也显著降低。

自1988年发现阿尔茨海默氏症由异常组装的tau蛋白组成，在大脑神经细胞内形成破坏性丝以来，Tau蛋白一直处于他工作的最前沿。

虽然其他几种药物专注于淀粉样蛋白，但HMTM有不同的作用方式，因为它针对tau蛋白的异常组装。这也是唯一完成第3阶段试验的口服tau疗法。

body:
another addition to the RWLV mgmt team - Resorts World Las Vegas (RWLV) has welcomed industry veteran Greg Shulman to the company in the role of executive vice president of international marketing. Greg's impressive career in the gaming industry is a testament to his leadership and relationships all over the globe," said Carlos Castro, COO and CFO of Resorts World Las Vegas. "He is widely regarded as one of the top player development executives in the industry, and we are thrilled to welcome him to our team as we continue to elevate our brand and expand our market reach."

Shulman will lead Resorts World Las Vegas' international casino marketing strategy, with a focus on high-end player development. He brings a wealth of experience to this role, having been a key member of the opening team at the Bellagio, where he held the title of executive director of marketing.

Most recently, Shulman served as the vice president of casino marketing for Palms Casino Resort, where he led enhancements to player development and guest relations. Shulman briefly departed the Vegas area to spearhead New Mexico's Sandia Resort & Casino reopening efforts as chief operating officer.

RWLV board chairman Jim Murren added: "Greg has a proven track record of executing marketing strategies that attract new audiences and drive financial growth. We are excited for Greg to continue expanding our global casino marketing efforts here at Resorts World Las Vegas, and we are confident he will be instrumental in supporting our ongoing success and development."

author: Chin
body:
研究发现：口服药片可在18个月内延缓阿尔茨海默病症恶化

研究人员报告称，可能存在一种口服疗法，可在至少18个月内延缓阿尔茨海默病病情恶化。

由新加坡公司卓睿药业（TauRx Pharmaceuticals Ltd）研发、总部位于阿伯丁的科学家团队表示，若获监管机构批准， 甲磺酸氢甲硫堇（HMTM）或将成为首款针对tau蛋白病理的阿尔茨海默病（AD）的口服疗法。

该发现公布在“2025国际阿尔兹海默症和帕金森氏病会议（AD/PD 2025）”上，该会议于上周六在维也纳落幕。会上，卓睿（TauRx）首席执行官兼联合创始人克劳德·维希克教授（Prof Claude Wischik）展示了HMTM近三期临床试验的结果，并与来自“阿尔茨海默病关键路径（CPAD）研究所”数据库中严格匹配的安慰剂组数据进行了对比。该数据库涵盖全球36项试验近10,000名患者的信息。

作为领导此项研究的维希克教授表示：“通过三项不同的分析方法将HMTM与外部数据对比，结果一致显示：HMTM可在至少18个月内有效减缓临床衰退以及脑萎缩，且在临床意义的疗效可能持续两年时间。”

“我们相信，HMTM有望为早期至轻/中度AD患者提供安全、便捷的口服治疗选择，其使用对于患者和医生来说负担极小。”

“尽管AD无法根治，但研究表明，在AD早期启动HMTM治疗可大幅延缓病情恶化。该药物在3,000多名患者的试验中展现出良好的安全性，加之口服给药方式，我们相信其将像其他处方药一样易于使用。”

目前，新加坡卓睿药业已向英国药品与保健品管理局（MHRA）提交HMTM的上市许可申请，并正与英国国家卫生和临床技术优化研究所（NICE）合作评估该药物纳入英国国民医疗体系（NHS）的适用性。

阿尔茨海默病评定量表-认知分量表(ADAS-cog13)评分系统用于评估患者执行任务的能力，如回忆词语和记忆测试指令。通过对比显示：早期AD患者服用HMTM后，18个月内基线评分未显著下降，而CPAD安慰剂组则呈现大幅衰退。

此外，用于评估痴呆严重程度的“临床痴呆评定量表（CDR）”显示类似结果。作为神经退化的客观指标，HMTM组的脑萎缩也显著减缓。

1988年，维希克教授发现阿尔茨海默病神经纤维缠结是由异常聚集的tau蛋白构成，这些蛋白在大脑神经细胞内形成破坏性纤维。自此以后，tau蛋白一直是其研究的核心。

目前多数药物聚焦于淀粉样蛋白，而HMTM的作用机制独特——靶向tau蛋白异常聚集。它也是唯一完成三期试验的口服tau疗法。

（吉隆坡8日讯）国家银行宣布，将法定储备金率（SRR）下调100个基点，从原本的2%降至1%，5月16日起生效。

国行在新闻稿中指出，此次下调法定储备金率，是国行持续努力确保国内金融体系流动性充足，旨在协助银行在当前金融市场波动加剧的环境下，更有效地管理流动性，并持续支持金融中介活动的运作。

此举预计将释放约190亿令吉的流动资金进入银行体系。

国行强调，法定储备金率是一项管理流动性的工具，并不代表货币政策立场的变化。货币政策的立场仅透过隔夜政策利率（OPR）来传达，并会在货币政策委员会会议后的货币政策声明中公布

body:
帝国交易须提供更多信息 云顶大马接交易所20问

Sinchew Thu, May 08, 2025 09:11pm（吉隆坡8日讯）云顶大马（GENM,4715,主板消费产品服务组）全购美国帝国度假村的举动，不但引起投资者关注，大马股票交易所今日更提出询问，要求该公司回答20道问题，以提供额外的信息。

云顶大马发文告表示，大马交易所是在5月6日发出提问信函，要求该公司在1天内回复。

交易所提出的问题，包括云顶帝国度假村公司（GERL）在之前是否有进行任何估值。

云顶大马答复，GERL未展开估值，因为相关估值应该由帝国度假村负责。GERL是投资控股公司，帝国度假村是其唯一资产。

而4100万美元收购价是考虑了营运协同效益、大股东林氏家族私人臂膀──建发的公司间贷款3970万美元，以及独立估值公司CBRE证券日期4月22日的估值报告。有关报告显示，帝国度假村的收购价是在市场价值3650万美元至4690万美元区间之内。

交易所也询问，由于Genting ER有限公司已经大幅投资于帝国度假村的优先股，令该集团拥有帝国度假村的90%经济利益，为何还要向建发收购GERL的剩余51%股权？

云顶大马则表示，完成收购后，帝国度假村将成为云顶大马的间接独资子公司，并通过Genting ER II LLC继续持有帝国度假村的优先股。

该公司收购GERL的51%会员利益（相等于帝国度假村的10%经济利益），将令云顶大马集团全面控制GERL以及帝国度假村，将可强化在纽约州博彩市场的地位，以在美国东北部有效竞争，以及和纽约市云顶世界达致营运协作效益。

body: Morning Vin. The tourism numbers in Apr for Singapore looks good. GenS revenue and ebitda has been growing qoq since Q3'24 to Q1'25 which is showing recovery picking up momentum. RWLV ebitda margins showing improvement in Q1'25 and the numbers from NGC for the Strip area in Apr looks good too. author: cheng
body:
First is to show recovery signs within the first 6 to 9 months :) If you cant show positive sign within the period, how do you expect others to be aligned with 12 to 18 months timeline. Changes in RWLV leadership - A megaresort on the Strip is, once again, making changes within its leadership ranks, moving two of its top recently appointed executives into new roles. Alex Dixon, who was named chief executive officer of Resorts World Las Vegas in January, will become a senior adviser to the company’s board of directors, the casino-hotel announced Thursday. Carlos Castro, hired as the property’s chief operating officer and chief financial officer in February, will assume the roles of president and CFO going forward.

According to the announcement, Castro “will lead the organization by continuing to attract top talent and usher Resorts World into the next stage of its growth.” In his new role, Dixon will “drive enterprise projects, build new strategic partnerships, and work to develop synergies across the Resorts World properties,” a post on the casino’s social media account read.

“Resorts World Las Vegas leadership knows our best days are around the corner, and this is the next phase in our evolution,” the LinkedIn post concluded.

On Wednesday, Castro addressed the Nevada Gaming Control Board as Resorts World Las Vegas’ parent company, Genting Berhad, had a pending matter before regulators. Castro told the board that the $4.3 billion resort, which was recently assessed a $10.5 million fine, the second largest in Nevada history, for allowing illegal bookmakers to gamble at the property, was in “recovery mode.”

Resorts World Las Vegas “has taken a hit over the last three quarters,” Castro told the GCB, specifically noting that the casino’s slot business has declined. A new senior vice president of slot operations is scheduled to start in June, the property’s new president told regulators.

“We do see recovery coming in 12 to 18 months as that business ramps up and we become more diligent in our marketing and sales efforts,” he said. “We’re comfortable and confident that business will return.”

body: that is something that the boss has to figure it out :) My job is simple - invest and monitor. if not ok, exit. For the boss, will he risk his prized assets? Two most expensive/valuable assets for Genting group is RWS and RWLV. The next review for RWS by GRA will be in Feb'26. The expectation is high for RWS to keep the tourists coming or risk losing the license over time. Having said that, it needs a lot of capex to keep the attractions updated. RWLV brought in independent oversight team (the BODs) to prevent a repeat of AML and it has to keep the numbers/margins up given that it is the most expensive resort in Las Vegas :) I can understand the Empire decision by Kien Huat/Genting group. It is only logical to preserve the resources for RWS and RWLV while GenM deals with Empire, shareholder dispute with RAV Bahamas, etc.

author: KengChew
body:
6月20日是四巫日。

四巫日（Quadruple witching day）也就是指每个季度（3月、6月、9月和12月）第三个星期里的周五，美国股市里所有的金融衍生品都会在这个时候到期并做一个结算与交割。

在四巫日中，股指期货、股指期权、个股期货与个股期权同时到期。 当日最后一个交易小时为四巫小时（Quadruple Witching Hour），即纽约时间下午三至四点。在到期时段内，交易量急剧增加，市场波动幅度加剧。

在“四巫日”的最后交易时段内，投资者急于平仓，导致交易量大幅增加。因此，“四巫日”通常伴随股票和衍生品价格的大幅波动。

通常在四巫日当天，马股也会有波动，尤其是在下午4点50分重新开市时，蓝筹股或各个大型股都可能会出现巨大的交易量。

6月20日这天，马股也可能会在临尾时突然出现大笔的交易。如果你持有马股的蓝筹股，也许你可以考虑在这个时段“投机”。

2025年的四巫日分别是2025年3月21日、2025年6月20日、2025年9月19日和2025年12月19日。

Aug last year was the start of the decline due to GenS results impacted by Hard Rock Hotel taken down for refurbishments resulting in lower RevPAR and the RWLV AML violation with fear of hundreds of millions fines with license being revoked coupled with GenM RAV Bahamas shareholder dispute. Fast forward, RWLV ebitda margins showing signs of margins compression in Q4'24 while AML violation fine (USD10mil) sorted out nicely. Q3FY25 will get a sneak preview with Laurus (replacing Hard Rock Hotel) opening and the bigger and better Oceanarium opening in July. The new BODs for RWLV has taken actions (marketing strategies) to entice visitors/tourists to its resorts for the coming summer which is a seasonally low traffic footfall in Las Vegas due to the hot weather. The impact of the action will be seen in Q3FY25 results. Phase one will be to recover from the panic sale driven by the Nevada fine and 2nd phase will be earnings recovery for GenS and RWLV.

author: Yong Yuan Erwin Tan
body:
我不是专家，但我全职做投资，想分享一下我的看法。

不管你怎么用对冲，跌了就是跌，最后还是得割肉止损。

股票涨的时候，对冲反而会把赚的钱吃掉。

大机构用期权是因为他们资金大，不能随便卖股票，不然会把价钱压低，所以他们用期权来保护自己。

我们散户不一样，钱少，随时可以卖，不会影响股价。

所以我们最好的“保险”就是——觉得不对就马上割，等稳了再买回来。

别盲目学大户用那些复杂工具，弄不好反而亏更惨。

我知道你用期权成交量看大机构动向的方法，理论上有道理。

但我经验是，这方法不一定每次都准，表现不稳定。

投资这东西，很多时候要看具体股票和市场情况，不能一概而论。

我的方法是练习看得比大机构更远，预测整个市场的走向，提前行动。

在大机构动之前，我已经有自己的判断。

而且我也学会了怎么分辨大机构什么时候在骗人或误导市场。这项技能叫做熟能生巧（TN）你是在投行做业务的吗？投资需要很多条件需要很多专家。从proposal 提出时经过推演不断运行还要精算师稠密推算得出胜算几何然后再评估风险回报比，才做部署。

author: KengChew
body:
截至目前，Genting New York LLC（即Resorts World New York City，RWNYC）尚未公布2024年完整的税后净利润数据。然而，根据S&P Global Ratings的报告，该公司在2024年前九个月的调整后息税折旧摊销前利润（EBITDA）为8300万美元，与2023年同期持平，收入同比增长4%，达到2.74亿美元。[1]

需要注意的是，RWNYC的税负较高，约为其老虎机收入的67%，这包括行政费用和其他支出。[2] 此外，Genting正在争取获得纽约市的完整赌场许可证，若成功，预计其年度税收贡献将从目前的6亿美元增加至超过10亿美元。[3]

由于高税率和运营成本，RWNYC的净利润可能相对较低。然而，随着可能的许可证扩展和业务增长，未来的盈利能力有望改善。

The only oral tau therapeutic to have completed Phase 3 trials, research suggests that if it is approved by regulators HMTM could slow the progression of Alzheimer’s disease – providing a major step forward in neurodegenerative disease research.

The company is committed to working with the MHRA and other bodies to address one of the world’s greatest unmet medical needs and eagerly awaits the outcome of the review.

Further updates on the application will be provided when appropriate.

author: Han Guan Lee
body:
Article by

*I AM LEGEND*

*Why Genting Malaysia Berhad (GENM) Is Poised To Become The Next Superstock?!*

TARGET PRICE : RM3.90

? Strong Reasons Why GENM’s Share Price Could Boom

1. High Growth Outlook

Analysts forecast GENM to grow earnings over 38% annually over the next three years—significantly above the ~12% market average. That strong growth supports its premium P/E ratio

2. Undervalued Stock with Upside

SimplyWall estimates GENM is trading ~44% below fair value (~RM2.3 vs intrinsic RM4.0)

This indicates significant upside potential

3. Bullish Analyst Targets

According to Fintel, the average 12‑month price target is RM2.50, with top estimates reaching RM3.98

4. Full Control of Empire Resorts

GENM is acquiring the remaining stake in Empire Resorts, which owns Resorts World Catskills, Resorts World Hudson Valley, and RW Bet (sports betting platform). This move consolidates its gaming footprint in New York, enhances operational control, and creates room for cost synergies and margin expansion.

There is also strong potential for Genting Berhad to merge Resorts World Las Vegas with GENM's New York casino assets and pursue a strategic listing in the United States — a move that could significantly unlock value and elevate global investor interest.

5. Global Resorts & Theme Parks Portfolio

GENM operates major integrated resorts globally—including Malaysia, UK, US, Bahamas, Singapore—driving diversified earnings from gaming, hospitality, F&B, and attractions .

6. Flagship Domestic Asset

Resorts World Genting and the new Genting SkyWorlds theme park are major tourist magnets, driving robust domestic cash flows

7. Strong Parent Clout

As part of the Genting Group (RM27 bn+ revenue, RM105 bn asset base), GENM benefits from financial strength, global brand, and group synergies

8. Attractive Dividend Yield

GENM currently yields about 5%, offering steady income and investor appeal amid market volatility

9. Recovery Play on Leisure Reopening

Post‑COVID, travel and tourism are rebounding. GENM stands to benefit from renewed domestic and international leisure demand (theme parks, casinos, hotels)

10. Technical & Sentiment Signal

Technical indicators (Moving Averages) on platforms like
Investing.com
show a "Strong Buy" signal. Plus, even after recent lows, sentiment and analyst ratings remain positive

body: valuing company like Genting Berhad is not an easy job, Kyory. Can be challenging even for a seasoned analyst due to Gent's presence in different countries, different business and with so many subsidiaries. And the complexity here means there will be different risks and growth. You can imagine assigning weightage to each individual business; the sotp as you mentioned. These weightage can change over time and not to mention the business/fundamentals. The good thing is Gent is at the bottom since the start of the Aug'24 downward movement and all the factors contributed to the momentum have been priced in and no longer a concern; recovery phase if you will :)

author: cheng
body: Genting Singapore's earnings may be dampened by macroeconomic uncertainties despite expectations of support from its post-renovation launches, DBS Group Research analysts say in a report. Regional tourists are likely to be more cautious on discretionary gaming spending due to economic pressures, they say, adding that these uncertainties are expected to persist into FY 2026. The analysts lower their FY 2025 and FY 2026 adjusted Ebitda estimates by 2% and 3%, respectively. There's also a risk of being excluded from the MSCI Singapore index amid its current share price weakness. DBS downgrades its rating to hold from buy and trims its target price to S$0.80 from S$0.90. Shares were last at S$0.735.

Article by I AM LEGEND

If Genting Berhad revalues all its major properties and assets to current market value, the net assets per share (NAPS) could increase by RM3.50 to RM6.00 per share

? Breakdown of Key Considerations:

? Genting Berhad Group’s Hidden Asset Value (Major Segments):

1. Resorts World Las Vegas (RWLV)

Cost: ~US$4.3 billion (~RM20 billion)

Book value is depreciated; market value likely higher due to strategic Strip location and rising land/hotel prices.

2. Genting Malaysia stake (49%)

GENM itself is undervalued due to historical cost of RWG, RWNYC, etc.

If GENM's revalued NAPS rises by RM2.00, Genting Berhad’s stake value uplifts by ~RM5.5B.

author: Diu DIU DIU
body:
旅游业这回事，我很想提醒各位，马来西亚的旅游业者旗舰是云顶，但是请看看这booking.com的review，只拿到5.3分，这分数是完全不及格的分数，一般上酒店需要6分以上才算及格，少过6分后果是什么？虽然没有明言，但是我们都猜到booking的algo是很少会推介6分以下的酒店，除非逼不得已。

这就是为什么，当大家搜索 云顶 这个字眼时，这个酒店的位置是直接推到很后面，几乎是不想让人家看到，毕竟哪怕花钱都好（佣金可以自行调整，给得越多就越靠前），这个排行还是反映马来西亚旅游业者的窘境：住宿不合格。

我们搜索Bali和Phuket，基本上都不会显示低于7分的酒店，大家就明白5.3分是什么理念。长期下去，能够招待的客人会是越往越下走，客户群也会逐渐萎缩。

有些公司已经是under investment了，长期不翻新和不投入资源，灯竞争一激烈起来整个公司就会突然翻车，那时才来搞翻新就太迟了，现金流既受到影响，资本开销又要举债。短期内看似安稳还可以产生现金流，但是长久下去基本上招牌不保。

author: KengChew
body:
截至2025年，云顶集团（Genting Group）在全球的土地资产主要集中在马来西亚和印度尼西亚，涵盖种植园、酒店、度假村和娱乐设施等多个领域。以下是其主要的土地资产概况：

---

? 全球土地资产概览

1. *种植园土地（Genting Plantations Berhad）*

- *总面积*：约260,371公顷（约643,500英亩），包括马来西亚和印度尼西亚的土地。

- *马来西亚*：约64,486公顷（约159,300英亩），主要分布在柔佛州、马六甲州、吉打州、霹雳州、雪兰莪州和沙巴州。

- *印度尼西亚*：约195,885公顷（约484,200英亩），主要位于西加里曼丹、中加里曼丹和南加里曼丹地区。 [1]

2. *酒店与度假村地产*

- *马来西亚*：云顶高原度假村（Resorts World Genting）位于彭亨州，占地面积约1,500英亩（约607公顷）。

- *新加坡*：圣淘沙名胜世界（Resorts World Sentosa）位于圣淘沙岛，占地约50公顷（约123英亩）。 [2]

- *美国*：

- *拉斯维加斯*：Resorts World Las Vegas，占地约88英亩（约35.6公顷）。

- *纽约市*：Resorts World New York City，占地约72.6英亩（约29.4公顷）。

- *纽约州Catskills*：Resorts World Catskills，占地约230英亩（约93公顷）。

- *英国*：Resorts World Birmingham，占地约59,000平方米（约14.6英亩）。

- *巴哈马*：Resorts World Bimini，占地约750英亩（约304公顷）。

---

? 总结

云顶集团在全球的土地资产主要包括：

- *种植园土地*：约260,371公顷（约643,500英亩）。

- *酒店与度假村地产*：

- 马来西亚：约1,500英亩（约607公顷）。

- 新加坡：约50公顷（约123英亩）。

- 美国：约390.6英亩（约158公顷）。

- 英国：约14.6英亩（约5.9公顷）。

- 巴哈马：约750英亩（约304公顷）。

这些土地资产支撑着云顶集团在全球范围内的多元化业务，包括种植、酒店、娱乐和房地产开发等。

UNLCOK VALUE AGAIN....PETALING JAYA: Genting Plantations Bhd has proposed to undertake a joint venture (JV) with Shouguang Vegetable Science and Technology Sdn Bhd (SVST) to develop approximately 70 acres of land in Kulai, Johor as a centre of excellence in tropical vegetable crops.

The plan is to have two separate companies: the JV Technology Co and JV Operating Co whereby Genting Plantations will hold the majority 60% with SVST the remainder, it said in a filing with Bursa Malaysia.

The initial share capital of the JV companies will be RM1,000 comprising 1,000 ordinary shares of RM1 each, it said.

This will eventually rise to an intended paid-up capital of RM210mil for the JV Technology Co and RM315mil for the JV Operating Co, it said.

TN，我剛入股市有看冷x的書，雖然他的書是寫給幼稚園看的，但是我到現在也不鼓勵身邊想學投資的人去看他的書。

書裡會強加很多概念給你，這些概念和理論當下讀的時候覺得可行，他會給你很多成功的例子去佐證，但是實戰後就會發現真實情況會常常和他的理論相反。

市場是dynamic不斷再進化的，投資和估值方法也不斷再變化。

投資要超越alpha值，就要比市場其他投資者還優秀，如果投資者還拿著以前的估值手法和概念來算今天的市場，絕對會被市場狠狠教訓。

author: MrPotato
body:
我不建議去看他書的原因，我打個比方。

冷X的方法是叫你用他的理論，不要質疑他的理論，閉上眼睛去開車。

如果你撞到了牆壁，你不要認為我的理論有錯，因為我的理論不會錯，你只要閉上眼繼續往前開，你一定可以把牆撞爛進入快車道。

如果你把他理論和其他投資大師比較，你會發現有很多的差別。

chalier munger 叫你每年把自己的舊觀念丟掉，強逼自己學習新觀念。

Howard mark叫你不斷學習和進步，想辦法做的比其他投資者優秀。

其他投資大師是叫你，“睜開雙眼，不斷修改和精進你的投資方式，市場不斷再變化，你自己要不斷level up，才能比其他投資者優秀。”

冷X的方法是“閉上眼睛，我的方法最好，所以用我的方法就好，有雜音不要理，相信就對了。”

我剛入股市時用冷X的觀念一直碰壁，後面把他的書丟一邊，強逼自己從關眼開車換成開眼開車。

開眼睛開車後當時才發現自己當初有蠢。

? 2022年第四季度业绩亮点

- *季度收入*：2.27亿美元，较2022年第三季度的2亿美元有所增长。

- *季度EBITDA（息税折旧摊销前利润）*：4700万美元，为开业以来的最高季度EBITDA。

- *酒店入住率*：达到89%，在3500间客房全部开放的情况下实现。

这一业绩的提升主要得益于会议业务的回归和内华达州游客数量的增加。然而，分析师指出，尽管EBITDA有所增长，

但考虑到每季度约2500万美元的利息支出和6000万美元的折旧费用，净利润仍面临压力。

每个季度还是需要拿3亿5700万来倒贴Rwlv ….

author: Yong Yuan Erwin Tan
body:
三十六计（兵书）

内容：:这是一部根据中国古代军事思想和斗争经验总结而成的兵书，共分为六套，六套分别代表了在优势和劣势情况下的不同战术。﻿

目的：:用于指导军事行动，是一种策略。﻿

来源：:被理解为对孙子兵法的总结，作者已不可考。﻿

七十二变（法术）

内容：

指的是一种道家高级法术，能够将自身变化为飞禽走兽、花草树木、器物或人形等各种形态。﻿

代表人物：

最著名的例子是《西游记》中的孙悟空，他通过七十二变来应对各种困难和危机，例如变作蚊虫探敌情，或变成二郎神的模样。﻿

其他：

在《西游记》中，像二郎神、大力牛魔王等角色也懂得七十二变，而猪悟能（猪八戒）则会天罡三十六变，但七十二变比天罡三十六变更高级。﻿

author: cheng
body: You are welcome, Vin. Agreed and it should be both GenS and RWLV. Between the two - GenS is heavy in capex (recovery and growth) while RWLV has to focus on optimization and marketing (recovery) due to the cyclicality. Following is the justification given for not issuing dividend - The Group will continue to exercise prudent capital management to support business needs to drive growth and pare down existing debt. As such, it makes sense for Genting's long term shareholders to monitor the group's net debt situation, GenS and RWLV recovery from the perspective for adjusted ebitda and margins :) Q2FY2025 total borrowings came down by 133mil compared to Q1FY2025 and net debt in Q2FY2025 is at 17.4bil; GenS and RWLV adjusted ebitda at 677 mil and 82 mil respectively. A full recovery + growth for GenS and RWLV should see its adjusted ebitda moving up above 1bil and 150 mil per qtr respectively. A good baseline for RWLV is that its adjusted ebitda should be 1.5x of GenM's US & Bahamas segment to justify the investment spent previously :) Hence, I will not be adding post qtr results unless I am seeing improvements / results for the metrics above due to the justification given for not issuing dividend. Show me the results first if you will :) Just my opinions, could be wrong. Hope it helps.

author: cheng
body: The latest report showing all the cash generated from ops went into capex for ppe and repayment of borrowings, Mirai. RWS 2.0 capex requirements will be substantial and RWLV optimization and improvements to attract VIPs will be critical to its recovery. Some signs of improvement in the latest qtr performance and barring any unforeseen circumstances, second half will be better given F1 and other events/convention. As for potential new bonds, it pretty much depends how the cash from the bonds will be utilized. Its either end of the spectrum - bad if the proceed is being used for capex as that will increase net debt / leverage; against the reasons for not issuing dividend which is support growth and pare down borrowings. Good if the proceed is being used to replace / refinance higher cost debt; net debt remains flat while debt maturity increases with better rates. Small retail investors will have to observe and weigh the decisions made by the BOD before blindly buying/adding. Funds/insti will be watching closely too and they are the "chart maker" given the resources they have :)

现金本身没有价值，它是一种交易工具和资产的衡量标准，而证券具有价值，因为它可以代表所有权（如股票）或债权（如债券），其价值会随市场供需、公司表现、宏观经济等因素而波动。因此，证券通常比现金更有潜在价值，但也伴随着更高的风险。﻿

author: cheng
body: that's a tough question, Vin :) The answer pretty much depends on leisure and hospitality segment since there are other segments like plantation, power, o&g, property and others. My take is that quarterly adjusted ebitda has to be at ~1.9 bil for at least a breakeven qr and preferably leisure and hospitality segment contributing most of it :) Ideally - GenS (1 bil), RWLV + GenM US segment (300 mil) + MY (600 mil). Anything higher than these numbers while other segments are generating positive adjusted ebitda will resulted in Gent reporting positive profit. The 1.9 bil estimate came from pg19 of Q2 report (depreciation + finance cost + impairment) + taxation from pg1. Q1 showing similar number and safe to assume 1.9 bil is the breakeven point assuming everything else is 0 :) Hence, the information in pg19 is always the first thing that I will look at for Gent's report.

author: cheng
body:
There were no updates on TauRx from Genting in the AGM presentation slides and question were raised later on. Standard answers were given :) Question 12 - What is the chances of getting approval from the British Medical Authority for the Alzheimer’s drug of TauRx?

Response to Question 12

Shareholders can visit TauRx Pharmaceuticals Limited (“TauRx”)’s website for updates on TauRx. On 1 July 2024, TauRx announced that it had submitted its application for marketing authorization with the UK Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (“MHRA”). TauRx has been accepted for fast-track processing by the MHRA.

On 1 November 2024, the MHRA issued an initial Request for Information (“RFI”), accompanied by detailed assessment reports covering all aspects of the application, including safety, efficacy, and the economic impact of the TauRx drug.

In June 2025, TauRx announced that it had completed and submitted all required responses to the MHRA’s RFI. The application is now under final review. TauRx anticipates a decision from the MHRA by the 3Q of 2025.

author: cheng
body: I did not track and monitor the eps for Gent, TN. I am monitoring adjusted ebitda as I am buying "turnaround" asset :) Nevertheless, you can use Q2FY2025 results as the baseline given that the positive happenings in the next few months in Singapore and Las Vegas. 240M for Q2 and 248M for first 6 months of FY2025. Q3 and Q4 can be estimated to achieve min 240M per qtr and that makes it 480M for Q3 and Q4; 728M for FY2025 and divided by NOSH giving it ~18.7 cents eps. As for 2026, recovery for RWS and RWLV will continue to make progress and visit malaysia 2026 will boost MY asset performance, safe to assume a 10% improvement from the baseline of 240M in Q2FY2025 for FY2026; min 264M per qtr, 1.056 bil for FY2026, ~27.2 cents eps.

author: cheng
body: the assumption here is that no changes to all other segments within the Genting group (plantation, power, O&G, etc). Did not include the possibility of higher contribution from O&G as the first drop of LNG estimated in Q3 of 2026. The finance cost may see a swing in 2026 - lower finance cost from lower interest rates for USD denominated loans but may ended up going higher due to RWNYC capital needs for the full casino license.

author: cheng
body: You are welcome, TN. I personally will not be worried too much on eps at this juncture as I am more concerned about the future investment / capex needs. Any further capex investments that are destroying value will not be good for the shareholders; particularly GenM's US Bahamas segment. It is better for the BODs to return it to shareholders via dividend / share buyback. Catskills and Hudson Valley is approx. 45 mins apart; cannibalization of footfall traffic is expected. There is the RWNYC which is about 2 hrs away from Catskills. Some form of consolidation is needed here to turnaround GenM's US Bahamas segment.

body: 要在股市猫下去，首先必须要有超强的记性和兴趣。我18岁的时候，当时的股市只有600家公司，公司背景大多数都记得一清二楚。98年风暴以前，是个大牛市，renong从几角钱冲破5快，人们陷入疯狂的状态，挂在5块的大量卖盘被我们华人在10分钟内吃到光，买到的人后来可以把股票挂在墙壁上做为纪念。巫统从股票市场上赚进大量的金钱，后来华人听到股票就说是政府在骗我们华人的钱，不可以买。Renong是一家怎样的公司？控股公司来的，旗下很多值钱的资产，报纸不断地报道公司有多好，虽然公司没有什么赚钱，当时谁也不会相信那么大的一家公司会消失掉…马华公会还有一家马化合作社也是这样……股票市场是政治人物，富商找钱的地方……

body: Tan大哥，道家修行讲究要做到形、气、神。医家在黄帝内经里头首先提到，养生必须要有到精、气、神。精化气，气化神，精乃形体之本。虽说医家比较早，但大家的中心思想还是一样的。佛家修行是要求做到戒、定、慧。戒是三戒，贪、嗔、痴，是不是需要戒了才能定呢？见仁见智，最后修成正果，而有大智慧，也就是有神。这就是为什么佛教能够在中华民族的文化里头，生根萌芽，发扬光大的原因。还有儒家教育人们要懂得中庸之道，能够保家安身立命之道。以上所说的任何一个门道都可以解决心理上，肉体上的痛苦，懂得的人，生活充满着乐趣，不会想不开，做傻事。股票只是数字上的游戏，钱多钱少，到头来结果都是一样，生不带来，死不带去。有幸在有生之年多做善事，多积福报，对自己对家人都是好的。

author: Kwong Mingkwei
body: 缺口补回，最好的表现是完全补回看不到缺口，而且站在缺口之上，那么要再上更高一层就很有希望。目前看到的是缺口不但补不回，而且往下掉那就坏事了，关键就再这几天放的好消息能否止跌回升，回去补回缺口。根据我的经验，要吗就直接冲上去补回，现在的情形不是好兆头，给我的话在这种时候又出好消息，我准备卖的。我以上说的缺口是最近发生的，很久以前的缺口，要想补回，十万八千里…学会看图，是玩股票的必修课。最后再说一句，一个大资本的股想要一起再起，越来越高，需要整个市场都看好它，如手套公司一样大家涌着去买才有可能的。小资本凭着老板一己之力就能办到，大不相同。

author: 小吴玩游戏
body:
综合推断：云顶是赚的（而且是对未来有利的）

从上述分析来看，可以合理总结：

这笔土地处置被市场普遍视为“正面”事件，即云顶通过卖地获取了高溢价，变现了一块增值很高的资产；

虽然出售土地也带走未来那块地作为种植用途的收入（棕榈油产量的贡献），但该地在集团总种植面积中占比极小，失去的棕榈收入不大（估算年损失 RM 1–2 百万）相比出售收益很小。 

出售所得款项可用于偿债、减少利息负担、或投入更有发展潜力的项目，从而提升集团的资金使用效率与盈利能力。 

多家研究报告在交易宣布后调升了 GENP 的目标价 /盈利预期，显示市场对其正面看法。 

所以，从分析师视角来看：云顶 是赚 的，这笔交易被认为是 “unlocking value”（释放资产价值）的一种策略，对未来是有积极意义的。

author: cheng
body:
3.0 Situations which may warrant suspension

3.1 The Exchange may approve a listed issuer’s request for suspension where -

(a) the listed issuer requires time to prepare and release an announcement relating to a

material transaction, such as -

(i) a very substantial transaction as defined in Chapter 10 of the Listing

Requirements;

(ii) a significant change in the business direction or policy of a listed corporation;

or(iii) any other corporate exercise which the Exchange considers to be material;

(b) the listed issuer intends to -

(i) make a material announcement, including one that falls within paragraph 3.2

below (“Very Material Announcement”); or

(ii) hold a press conference to make a Very Material Announcement,

before the close of trading; or

(c) any other reason which, in the opinion of the Exchange, justifies a suspension.

3.2 Without limiting the above, an announcement relating to any of the following matters will be

regarded as a Very Material Announcement:

(a) an interim financial report;

(b) a bonus issue or fund raising exercise;

(c) a transaction as defined under paragraph 10.02(l) of the Listing Requirements, where the percentage ratio calculated in accordance with Chapter 10 of the Listing Requirements is 25% or more;

(d) a notice of take-over being served on a listed issuer which the public has no prior

knowledge of; or

(e) any other corporate exercise.

body:
MGM's withdrawal from NY casino project leaves Genting, two other bidders in the race::

Oct 15): MGM Resorts International pulled out of the competition to operate a casino in the New York area, leaving three companies vying for three possible licences to build gambling palaces serving the largest US city.

The Las Vegas-based resort and gambling company blamed shifting economic and competitive conditions, including a shorter-than-expected duration for its licence, according to a statement Tuesday.

“The newly defined competitive landscape — with four proposals clustered in a small geographic area — challenges the returns we initially anticipated from this project,” MGM said.

author: Do Do
body:
美高梅国际度假村（MGM Resorts International）决定退出纽约下州（Downstate）赌牌竞标活动，仅存包括云顶（GENTING，3182，主板消费股）在内的3家公司竞标最多3张赌牌，意味着云顶已胜券在握。

根据彭博社报道，随着美高梅最后一刻退出，仍在竞标的公司从几个月前的8家，缩减至如今的3家，云顶是其中之一。

目前，剩余的竞标者，仍需在当地时间周二（14日）提交最终竞标计划书，阐明他们愿意支付的执照费和税率等。

英国药品和保健产品监管局 (MHRA) 对 HMTM 上市许可申请的回应

TauRx Therapeutics Management Ltd 确认已收到英国药品和保健产品监管局 (MHRA) 的正式确认，需要进一步的信息才能最终确定氢甲硫氨酸甲磺酸盐 (HMTM) 作为阿尔茨海默病潜在口服治疗药物的适用性。

TauRx 的同事正在处理该请求，以确保尽快收集答复。

公司致力于根据需要与 MHRA 和其他机构合作，并将适时提供进一步的更新信息。

MHRA response to HMTM Marketing Authorisation Application

TauRx Therapeutics Management Ltd can confirm it has received formal confirmation from the UK Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (MHRA) that it requires some further information before a final determination on the suitability of hydromethylthionine mesylate (HMTM), as a potential oral treatment for Alzheimer’s disease, can be reached.

TauRx colleagues are in the process of working through the request in order to ensure answers are collated as expediently as is practicable.

The company is committed to working with the MHRA and other organisations as required, and further updates will be provided in due course.

author: hg lee
body:
Positive if attempt to take

GENM private successful

Maintain BUY with higher SOTP-TP of MYR3.94 (+6%)

GENT made a conditional voluntary take-over offer (VTO) to GENM to

acquire the 2.87b (51%) shares in GENM it does not own for MYR2.35/shr

cash. At first glance, this deal does not appear favourable for GENT but

after taking into consideration the potential catalysts currently accruing

to GENM, we estimate that its earnings could be boosted by ≤51% and

SOTP-fair value to MYR4.25. For now, we raise our SOTP-TP to MYR3.94

(MYR3.70 previously) to account for a higher GENM SOTP-TP.

author: Sf Wong
body:
2025年10月18日

云顶（GENTING）近期动作频频。

宣布以每股2.35令吉、总值67亿令吉全面收购云顶大马（GENM）未持有股份后，短短几天内再度出手，通过公开市场狂砸近1亿令吉买入云顶大马，成交价介于2.31令吉至2.33令吉之间，全部低于要约价。

市场分析认为，母公司此举展现出强烈信心。

目前云顶已持有超过50%，收购要约已自动生效，若再达75%或90%，甚至可能触发下市或强制收购。

有分析员指出，这次收购与云顶大马竞标纽约下州赌场执照密切相关，该项目投资额高达230亿令吉，母公司希望整合财务实力以助融资。更关键的是，随着竞争者美高梅国际退出竞标，云顶被视为胜算最高的候选之一。

投资界意见分歧，有人认为2.35令吉偏低、云顶大马潜在价值更高；也有人认为这价提供不错的离场机会。

不论结果如何，这场“父子豪赌”，已成为市场焦点。

专注私有化云顶大马 云顶推迟美非博彩资产脱售

Sinchew Thu, Oct 23, 2025 12:51pm - 39 minutes

（吉隆坡23日讯）云顶（GENTING,3182,主板消费产品服务组）以5亿2500万美元（约令吉）脱售卡斯基名胜世界（Resorts World Catskills）非博彩资产给萨利文县度假村设施地方发展公司（SCRFLDC）的计划将推迟至2026年1月初进行，以专注完成云顶大马（GENM,4715,主板消费产品服务组）私有化计划。

云顶美国东部（Genting America East）首席财务员沃尔特博古米尔（Walter Bogumil）在周一（20日）于萨利文县度假村设施地方发展公司会议上宣读公开信，称延迟交易的原因在于云顶正全面献购子公司云顶大马，因此无法同时进行其他重要交易。

body:
RAM Affirms Genting Group’s AA1 Ratings; Cautions Limited Debt Headroom

RAM Ratings has reaffirmed the AA1/Stable/P1 corporate credit ratings of Genting Berhad and Genting Malaysia Berhad (GenM), maintaining confidence in the group’s diversified business profile and strong liquidity despite potential leverage pressures stemming from its proposed privatisation of GenM.

In its latest review, the ratings agency said GenM’s ratings continue to reflect its close operational integration with Genting and a “very high” likelihood of parental financial support if required.

RAM noted that Genting’s robust business profile remains underpinned by its diversified global footprint across the gaming and leisure sectors in Malaysia, Singapore and the United States, alongside interests in plantations, power generation, property and oil and gas. These sectors, it said, help mitigate concentration risk and provide a steady foundation for the Group’s earnings.

author: Hong Chew Eu
body:
Genting’s Big Move: Will the VTO Fix a Low-Return Giant?

Genting has been in the news recently with its voluntary takeover (VTO) proposal to acquire the remaining 51% of Genting Malaysia Berhad that it does not already own.

In my article written before this announcement, I raised concerns about Genting’s weak ROIC, weighed down by a high fixed-cost base. I viewed Genting more as a defensive cash generator than a true growth compounder. Refer to
https://www.i4value.asia/2025/10/genting-berhad-asset-rich-but-return.html#more

The VTO signals strategic intent — to unlock better capital allocation, simplify the group structure, and pursue big-ticket ambitions such as potential U.S. expansion.

The move does not change Genting’s underlying operational and efficiency challenges; those remain the key hurdles to long-term value creation.

The weakness lies in capital efficiency — ROIC has rarely cleared 7%. EPS has shrunk over the past decade, and large expansions like Resorts World Las Vegas have lifted fixed costs without delivering matching returns. Unlocking value depends on redeploying cash into higher-return projects and narrowing the gap between ROIC and WACC.

The VTO may simplify Genting’s structure, but only higher returns — not bigger bets — can fix a low-return giant.

author: hg lee
body:
云顶集团（Genting Berhad）@2026年度超级股票 ?

1️⃣ 历史证明一切 @ 成功模式再度上演

在云顶赢得圣淘沙综合度假村（Resorts World Sentosa）牌照之前，集团曾经成功私有化云顶新加坡（Genting Singapore），以便集中资源、统一决策，赢取最终胜利。

如今相同的布局正在重演——云顶集团已全面准备，几乎笃定拿下纽约州全赌场牌照。

历史告诉我们：每当云顶在重大里程碑前完成整合或私有化，股价必将迎来巨大重估。

2️⃣ 云顶大马@稳定现金牛，集团核心支柱

云顶马来西亚（Genting Malaysia Berhad, GENM）仍是集团的现金引擎，

凭借稳定的EBITDA与强劲的自由现金流，支撑集团的全球扩张。

疫情后业绩强劲复苏，一旦进行结构重组或重新上市，将释放数十亿令吉的潜在资产价值，为母公司云顶集团带来显著增值。

3️⃣ 美国资产整合 @ “Genting USA” 即将诞生

云顶有望将旗下所有美国赌场资产——包括

Resorts World New York City、Resorts World Hudson Valley 与 Resorts World Las Vegas——

整合成一个统一平台，成立 “Genting USA”。

未来更可能在美国道琼斯或纳斯达克上市，

让云顶集团直接对接全球资本市场，与 Las Vegas Sands、MGM Resorts 等国际巨头平起平坐。

4️⃣ 英国版图扩张 @ 隐藏的价值宝藏

鲜为人知的是，云顶在 2025年已完成多项英国赌场收购，低调地扩大欧洲版图。

未来极可能将英国所有资产整合为 “Genting UK”，

并计划在 伦敦证券交易所（LSE） 上市，

让云顶在欧洲的估值与曝光度全面提升。

5️⃣ 马来西亚业务重组 @“新云顶马来西亚” 或将登场

集团有望将马来西亚境内的赌场、酒店与娱乐产业重组整合为 “新云顶马来西亚（New Genting Malaysia）”，

并重新在 马股主板（Bursa Malaysia） 上市。

此举将重新评估并释放长期被低估的核心资产价值，

同时吸引更多国际资金关注马来西亚旗舰业务。

6️⃣ Taurex 项目 @ 2026年重大催化

备受瞩目的 Taurex 生命科技项目 预计将在 2026年获得全面审批，

标志着云顶正式进军 生物科技与健康创新领域。

这不仅提升集团的 ESG形象，

也为云顶带来更高成长性与利润率的新产业支柱。

7️⃣ 发电资产上市 @ 基础设施价值释放

云顶集团旗下的发电与能源资产长期被低估，

一旦分拆或独立上市，将释放数十亿潜在市值，

确立云顶作为区域性能源基础设施龙头的地位。

8️⃣ 能源业务扩展 @ FLNG 发展潜力巨大

集团的 浮式液化天然气（FLNG）项目 是能源板块的关键突破，

预计投产后将带来稳定的美元计价收入，

进一步强化云顶的全球能源布局与盈利多元化。

9️⃣ 迈阿密土地变现 @巨额现金回流

云顶持有美国迈阿密市中心极具价值的海滨地块，

未来通过出售或合作开发，有望实现 约RM4至5亿令吉（约10亿美元）资金回笼，

大幅降低集团负债比并增强现金流。

? Empire Resorts 非核心资产剥离

旗下 Empire Resorts Inc.（帝国度假村） 预计在 2026年第二季度 完成

非核心资产处置。

届时 Empire 预计将实现零负债及稳健盈利，

为未来纳入 “Genting USA” 整合平台铺平道路。

? 结论：2026 —— 云顶集团的重生之年

随着多个全球级催化剂陆续到来：

纽约州全赌场牌照

美国与英国双地上市计划

Taurex 项目核准

能源与发电业务上市

迈阿密与帝国资产变现

云顶集团正迈入历史性的价值重估周期。

? 一切迹象清晰表明：

> 云顶集团（Genting Berhad）必将成为2026年度的 No.1 超级股票！

body:
GENTING BERHAD — MALAYSIA’S SLEEPING GIANT ABOUT TO AWAKEN

“When history repeats, fortunes are made.”

A GLOBAL CONGLOMERATE READY TO EXPLODE IN VALUE

While most investors chase small stories and short-term trades, the real professionals are quietly accumulating one counter — Genting Berhad (3182).

For years, Genting Berhad has been deeply undervalued, trading far below its true net asset value (over RM11 per share but if based on latest revaluation, the NTA might reach over RM13.80 per share).

But 2026 will not be “just another year.”

It will be the turning point, where all of Genting’s global engines fire together — casino, energy, biotech, property, and tourism — pushing it into a new golden era.

Make no mistake: Genting Berhad is about to become Bursa Malaysia’s No.1 Super Stock.

1)History Never Lies — The Sentosa Blueprint Repeats

Before winning the Sentosa integrated resort license, Genting quietly privatized Genting Singapore, restructured internally, and shocked the world by securing Singapore’s most lucrative casino license.

Fast forward to today — Genting Berhad is playing the same winning game plan:

Privatize Genting Malaysia, consolidate all U.S. operations, then emerge as the only fully integrated operator ready for New York’s full casino license.

History is repeating itself — and every time it does, Genting’s shareholders become the big winners.

2)The New York Jackpot — A License Worth Billions

All eyes are now on the New York State Gaming Commission, and every credible source points to one frontrunner: Genting.

Genting already operates Resorts World New York City, a proven, tax-paying success story for over a decade.

MGM has stepped aside. Wynn has withdrawn. Bally’s faces major financing hurdles.

That leaves Genting as the only ready and fully compliant contender with existing infrastructure.

Winning this license will instantly transform Genting’s U.S. portfolio into a cash machine — potentially generating over USD 1 billion in annual EBITDA and pushing the group’s valuation to levels unseen in Malaysian corporate history.

3)The Silent Cash Empire — Genting Malaysia

While investors debate short-term prices, Genting Malaysia quietly delivers steady profits and robust cash flow from its Resorts World Genting operations.

Once privatized, its earnings will fully flow into Genting Berhad —

# Stronger consolidated profit

# Higher EPS and NTA

# Simplified ownership and reduced valuation discount

The privatization is not a rumor — it’s a strategic inevitability.

Even short sellers know it — having covered back more than 20 million shares recently, reducing their positions from 32.8 million to just 11.6 million.

When short sellers retreat, the smart money steps in.

4)Global Expansion — From Las Vegas to London

Genting has spent the past few years building quietly but strategically:

Expanded ownership in Resorts World Las Vegas, a USD 4.3 billion integrated resort on the Strip.

Acquired additional UK casino assets, paving the way for a potential “Genting UK” listing in London.

Consolidating Empire Resorts under one brand — creating the foundation for Genting USA, which could one day list on Dow Jones or Nasdaq.

Each region — Asia, U.S., U.K. — is now a profit engine waiting for full synergy under Genting’s corporate umbrella.

5)Hidden Value — Billion-Dollar Assets Waiting to Unlock

What the market has failed to price in are Genting’s hidden gems:

# Miami Waterfront Land: Estimated worth RM4.5–RM5.0 billion, ripe for monetisation.

# FLNG (Floating LNG) Project: Poised to contribute sustainable USD revenue starting 2026.

# Power Assets: Ready for separate listing — could unlock billions in hidden value.

# Taurex Project: Expected government approval in 2026, signaling Genting’s entry into biotech and future energy.

Each catalyst alone is massive. Combined — they redefine Genting’s valuation floor.

6)The Balance Sheet Power — Strong, Liquid, and Ready

Genting is not a dream story — it’s cash-backed reality.

Over RM20 billion in cash and liquid assets.

Manageable gearing, diversified revenue in USD, SGD, GBP, and MYR.

Continuous positive cash inflow from Malaysia, Singapore, U.S., and U.K. operations.

This means Genting doesn’t just survive economic cycles — it thrives in them.

7)Re-Rating Wave Coming — From RM3 to RM9+

At current levels (RM3–RM4), Genting trades at barely one-third of its true intrinsic value.

Once privatization is confirmed, and the New York license officially announced, analysts expect a rapid re-rating to RM8–RM9, with RM10+ achievable once U.S. listing plans progress.

That’s not speculation — it’s math.

The market simply cannot ignore RM11+ NTA with global catalysts firing simultaneously.

9)The Investor’s Dream Setup

#Global catalysts aligned

#Strong balance sheet

#Clear strategic roadmap

#Short sellers retreating

#Asset monetization in motion

#Management with proven history of delivering big wins

Every great rally begins with disbelief — and we are standing at that exact moment now.

2026: The Year of Genting’s Great Awakening

In 2026, Genting will not just be a Malaysian story — it will be a global story.

From New York to Las Vegas, from Miami to the Highlands, Genting’s brand, assets, and momentum will finally merge into one unstoppable force.
